Loss  of  voluntary  motion  without  loss  of  consciousness.

Giddmess  and  faintness  without  uneasiness.

Paralyses  motor  nerves,  but  does  not  impair  sensibility,

Cause  of  death,  true  suffocation,  never  causes  paralysis  of  heart.
^^  Sleep.     Intense  sleepiness.
